Title: Personal Support Worker (PSW)
Summary: Give safe, respectful, person-centred support to residents and clients across Ontario.
About the role: Power Care is seeking compassionate and dependable Personal Support Workers (PSWs) to provide safe, respectful and person-centred support to clients, patients and residents. Duties vary according to the care environment, care plan and individual needs.
Responsibilities:
Assist with activities of daily living including personal hygiene, grooming, dressing, toileting and other personal-care needs.
Support safe mobility, positioning and transfers using approved methods/equipment within training and assigned responsibilities.
Assist with meals, feeding and hydration where required.
Promote independence, comfort, dignity, privacy and emotional well-being.
Observe and promptly report changes in physical condition, behaviour, cognition, mobility or overall well-being.
Follow individualized care/service plans and care-team directions.
Complete required care documentation and incident reporting accurately and on time.
Apply applicable infection prevention, workplace safety, privacy and confidentiality practices.
Communicate professionally with clients, residents, families, nurses, supervisors and interdisciplinary team members.
Perform only duties for which appropriate education, training, competence and authorization have been established.
Requirements:
Qualifications appropriate to the assignment. Where Ontario law prescribes a PSW qualification pathway, the candidate must satisfy the applicable pathway.
Power Care may verify an applicable PSW certificate/diploma, HSCPOA status or another recognized pathway where relevant.
Strong personal-care/ADL support skills and respect for dignity, privacy and professional boundaries.
Effective communication, observation, documentation and reporting skills.
Reliability, professionalism, sound judgment and ability to work independently and collaboratively.
Ability to safely perform essential assignment duties, with accommodation where required.
Assignment requirements:
Applicable police record screening / Vulnerable Sector Check.
CPR and/or First Aid.
TB, immunization or occupational-health documentation.
IPAC and workplace safety / WHMIS instruction.
N95 fit testing.
Dementia-care education such as GPA or equivalent.
Lift/transfer competency.
Driver's licence and vehicle for community assignments.
Nice to have:
Long-term care, retirement, home/community care, dementia, palliative, complex care or hospital experience.
PointClickCare or other healthcare documentation experience.
Additional training relevant to the client population.
